caption:
Figure 1: We present PCAsplat, a geometric regularization of Gaussian splatting that aligns Gaus-
sians with surfaces through differentiable local PCA. Compared with current methods, PCAsplat
substantially reduces floaters (left) and produces cleaner point clouds with better surface coverage
(center). This improved point-cloud enables downstream tasks such as instance segmentation (right).
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final and initial draft, read caption and all independent checks. Final source loader, wheel insets, both statue reconstructions and three room instance outputs retain original points, geometry, labels and comparison ordering. The added floaters/surface-coverage/instance-segmentation headings directly reflect caption. The color key identifies instance outputs only and does not imply corresponding instance colors between methods. The full scientific rectangle is independently restored exactly.
